sources.title: Qwen explained: Alibaba's open AI models, from phone-sized to flagship
sources.snippet: Qwen is a family of open-weight AI models from Alibaba's Qwen team, and it covers more ground than almost any other open line: a phone-class model under 1 billion parameters on one end, flagship models with hundreds of billions of parameters on the other.
